### ✨ New Features

* add Yandex Weather support ([588367d](https://github.com/Basil-AS/ru-apps-patches/commit/588367d584e0dabeb8a7329aa204a9552c1fe522))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.

patches.name: Block listings
patches.description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).

patches.name: Bypass RootBeer root detection
patches.description: Stubs calls into the scottyab/rootbeer native root-checking library so it always reports a clean (non-rooted) result.

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer attribution/tracking: no-ops its SDK implementation's start() choke point (the actual activation entry point, called directly from app code — not manifest-gated in the v6+ SDK) and disables its install-referrer manifest entries.

patches.name: Disable analytics libraries
patches.description: Disables runtime analytics tracking calls and initializers (AppMetrica, MyTracker, Firebase).

patches.name: Disable analytics manifest components
patches.description: Disables analytics and tracking components and metadata in AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics, Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper, AppMetrica, and Varioqub A/B-test reporting.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Prevents Avito's force-update screen opener from launching update screens. Toggleable in Настройки Morphe.

patches.name: Hide professional sellers
patches.description: Adds a maximum seller review count to Avito search filters and hides or dims offers from sellers above that limit.

patches.name: Morphe settings
patches.description: Adds a "Настройки Morphe" entry to Avito's settings that hosts the configuration for the other Morphe patches.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables Avito ads by removing ad SDK entry points and short-circuiting commercial banner loading.

patches.name: UI tweaks
patches.description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide reserved offers and offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, optionally hide profile sections (recommendations, tools, services, jobs), and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.

patches.description: Disables the STCrypt/CKey SDK's aggregate root-detection check so it always reports a clean (non-rooted) result.
